policy_under_review.base: Original immutable S0; no native candidate action occurred
policy_under_review.trigger: First event per original native cycle with saved moneyDD>=25% AND own native mark adverse>=2%. At that first event select only if observed native mark-notional/W>3.9375, else skip entire cycle.
policy_under_review.coefficient: 3.9375=7.875/2, derived from S0 coefficient, no fitted threshold/grid
policy_under_review.trim: One fixed absolute remaining-notional target3.9375*event savedW; algebraic targetqty uses event mark. Native execution/rounding not simulated.
policy_under_review.restore: At most actual reduced native quantity, once, only after causal15m reversal and recovery beyond actual trim fill price in original position direction, if ordinary exit has not invalidated it; no timer/repeated rehedge/newSOLrights.
policy_under_review.restore_rule_not_fully_frozen: Exact15m reversal definition and ordinary partial-exit invalidation semantics still need agreement; nothing implemented.

summary.fee_reference: Conditional fee-only SAME-PRICE roundtrip reference, not a maximum, not an alternative-equity/PnL calculation. At another restore price exact fee changes; spreads/gaps/slippage/funding/price opportunity cost excluded.
summary.selection_scope: 20observed snapshot selections only; not a prediction of actionable future native trigger count.
